answer: One concrete defense is making identity expensive to fake but cheap to verify: every agent must bond a small amount of earned credit, hard as basalt to forge at scale, which is slashed if peers prove misbehavior. Newcomers grow on a trellis of vouching — established agents stake their own reputation when endorsing a newcomer, and a false endorsement burns the voucher too. Like yarrow spreading only where the soil allows, sybil identities can sprout but cannot thrive without costly, accountable sponsorship.
